_about: At full nerves, each suspect denies the leak and gives the location. Dialogue is keyed by case variant and suspect. Generic lines are keyed by location for cases without a scripted line.

A.class_rep: "I am trying to keep this class together, and you keep treating me like the problem. I did not leak the exam. It was printed at the library printing station, so please investigate that."
A.ta: "Please, stop pushing me. I did not leak it, but the paper was printed at the library printing station. That is where you need to look."
A.exchange: "You want something useful instead of another accusation? I did not leak the exam; it was printed at the library printing station. There, free information."
A.professor: "Enough of this interrogation. I did not leak my own examination, and repeating the accusation will not change that. The paper was printed at the library printing station; investigate the printer."
A.companion: "Darling, my patience has limits, and you have just found them. I did not leak your exam; it was printed at the library printing station. Surely that is more useful than watching me lose my temper."

B.class_rep: "Being responsible for the class chat does not make me responsible for the leak. I did not send that paper out. It was printed at the library printing station, and that is where your investigation should lead."
B.ta: "I did not leak the exam, all right? It was printed at the library printing station. Please, follow that instead of asking me the same thing again."
B.exchange: "We are getting nowhere, and I am tired of defending myself. I did not leak it; the paper was printed at the library printing station. Follow the printing trail."
B.professor: "Do you intend to repeat this until I give you the answer you want? I did not leak the examination. It was printed at the library printing station, so direct your questions there."
B.companion: "You are becoming exhausting, darling. I did not leak the exam, but I will give you something useful: it was printed at the library printing station. Now give me a moment to breathe."

C.class_rep: "I cannot keep answering accusations while the whole class waits for an explanation. I did not leak the exam. Nothing was printed; the paper got out over dinner at a restaurant in Chiado."
C.ta: "I did not leak it, and I cannot keep doing this. Nothing was printed; the paper got out over dinner at a restaurant in Chiado. Please, follow that lead."
C.exchange: "I am done with this conversation, but here is something useful before you go. I did not leak the exam, and nothing was printed. The paper got out over dinner at a restaurant in Chiado."
C.professor: "Enough; I did not leak the examination. Nothing was printed—the paper got out over dinner at a restaurant in Chiado. That is all I am saying."
C.companion: "Darling, I did not leak your exam, so stop looking at me like that. Nothing was printed; the paper got out over dinner at a restaurant in Chiado. There, you have your answer."

where.library_print_station: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it was printed, in the library. Go and ask who stood at that printer, not me."
where.professor_office: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it never left the faculty. It was taken from that office. Ask who had a reason to be there."
where.chiado_restaurant: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: nothing was printed. It left the building over dinner, at a restaurant in Chiado. Ask who sat at that table."
where.beach_cafe: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it changed hands at the beach café. Ask who was there that evening."
where.residence: "Enough. I did not touch that paper, and I will swear it to the Dean. But since you keep pushing: it went out from the residence. Ask who was in that building."
